note: The National Park Service account developed with the Gifu battlefield museum estimates about 80,000 soldiers on each side before defections. Some contingents remained inactive, and the reconstruction does not simulate their changing allegiance. Matchlockmen are representative of documented firearms use, not the whole troop composition. The source estimates about 30,000 deaths overall without dividing them between camps; that total is not split or applied to individual formations.
